name: Carry Conditioned on Trend
description: Ranks assets by ex-ante carry (yield-to-maturity for bonds, dividend yield for equities, storage cost for metals), selects top_n by carry, then filters by asset-level trend (6-12m positive return). Assets failing trend filter route weight to VUTY (safe asset) or renormalize. Implements Baz, Granger, Harvey, Le Roux & Rattray (2015) — carry earns a premium but crashes in risk-off episodes; trend is a cheap proxy for crash state, so filtering carry by trend cuts left tail while retaining premium.
